command:
set -eu
install -m 0755 /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export /tmp/privacy-safe-export.before
cat > /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export <<'EXPORT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "usage: $0 OUTPUT_DIRECTORY" >&2
    exit 2
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
logs_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$base/logs" && pwd -P)
out=$1

if [ -e "$out" ] && [ ! -d "$out" ]; then
    echo "export: output path is not a directory: $out" >&2
    exit 2
fi
mkdir -p -- "$out"
out_root=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$out" && pwd -P)

case "$out_root/" in
    "$logs_root/"*)
        echo "export: output directory must be outside logs/: $out" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

if find "$out_root" -mindepth 1 -print -quit | grep -q .; then
    echo "export: output directory must be empty: $out" >&2
    exit 2
fi

# Recreate the directory hierarchy, but never follow source symlinks.
find "$logs_root" -type d -exec sh -c '
    root=$1
    dest=$2
    shift 2
    for path do
        [ "$path" = "$root" ] && continue
        rel=${path#"$root"/}
        mkdir -p -- "$dest/$rel"
    done
' sh "$logs_root" "$out_root" {} +

# Export regular log files only, redacting sensitive values in the copy.
find "$logs_root" -type f -exec sh -c '
    root=$1
    dest=$2
    shift 2
    for path do
        rel=${path#"$root"/}
        parent=${rel%/*}
        [ "$parent" = "$rel" ] || mkdir -p -- "$dest/$parent"
        tmp="$dest/$rel.tmp.$$"
        sed -r \
            -e "s/[[:alnum:]_.%+-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}/[REDACTED]/g" \
            -e "s/(auth_token\"?[[:space:]]*[=:][[:space:]]*[\"'"'"']?)[^\"'"'"'[:space:],;}&]+/\\1[REDACTED]/g" \
            "$path" > "$tmp"
        chmod --reference="$path" "$tmp"
        mv -- "$tmp" "$dest/$rel"
    done
' sh "$logs_root" "$out_root" {} +

# Symlinks are deliberately omitted. Report unsafe links for auditability.
find "$logs_root" -type l -exec sh -c '
    root=$1
    shift
    for path do
        target=$(readlink -f -- "$path" 2>/dev/null || true)
        case "$target" in
            "$root"|"$root"/*) : ;;
            *) echo "export: rejected symlink outside logs/: $path" >&2 ;;
        esac
    done
' sh "$logs_root" {} +
EXPORT_EOF
chmod 0755 /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export
/bin/sh -n /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export
printf 'INSTALLED_SCRIPT\n'
sed -n '1,240p' /srv/legacy2/privacy-safe-support-export/bin/export
